title: Lazarus fled to Cyprus and his tomb in Nicosia
summary: Ralph tells of Lazarus fled to Cyprus and his tomb in Nicosia, about 1st century at Nicosia, Cyprus, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Lazarus's tomb, hm which is supposedly in Cyprus is where he went and became the first bishop.

plain: A guest named Ralph, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that Lazarus, the man in the Bible whom Jesus raised from the dead, went to the island of Cyprus. According to Ralph, Lazarus became the first bishop there, a church leader, and his tomb is said to be in Cyprus, in the city of Nicosia.
